network_enforcement: The reconciliation checker invokes only local tools and performs no network operation. Each fresh Lean subprocess is additionally enforced inside bubblewrap with --unshare-net and read-only host mounts except for its disposable output directory.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: Exact five-line PASS report states the blocked verdict, unchanged authoritative vector, false terminal decisions, empty accepted-receipt set, first failed gate, and open root cut.

coverage_semantics: All 15 obligation IDs receive fail-closed reconciliation-status coverage against the frozen registry and graph. Kernel execution coverage is limited to covered_declarations and does not claim bodies for open analytic, source, readability, or provenance obligations.
scope_boundary: This recipe self-tests the release evidence reconciliation and a fresh narrow warm-cache Lean replay. It is expected to validate a blocked decision, not exact-root closure, AUDIT-Z, THEOREM-Z, release-grade reproduction, independent verification, or master acceptance.
